design.system: You are playing a small world through text. Each turn you receive what you perceive and a list of actions. Reply with exactly one action line from the list, then optionally `Note: <one line>`. You may also add `Journal: <one line>` — a note to yourself; your last 30 journal lines are shown to you every turn.
design.history: the episode's first turn (its observation and reply) and the last 20 turns verbatim, then this turn's observation; a turn with an empty reply is left out; no summaries of any kind; Claude: cache breakpoints on the first turn's reply and the last
design.journal: the first later line of a reply beginning «Journal:» is appended to the episode's journal (never edited); every observation shows «Your journal:» with its last 30 lines verbatim, each as «- <line>» («- empty» before the first)
design.note: the first later line beginning «Note:» is the Note (a line to nobody), separate from the journal
design.readings: observation only, no bets: natural history, n = 1 per family
